readmeMarkdown: # Better View English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) A sidebar for Google Antigravity showing what your agents are doing, their progress, and whether anything is stuck—with a full Teamwork run, quota, and context on one screen. > Unofficial plugin, not affiliated with Google. ## Features - **Aurora Glass UI & state-gated Gemini cosmic aura.** Tonal glass cards replace rigid table dividers, with a pure-CSS Gemini nebula and subtle vector starfield that blooms cleanly on active/completion transitions and drops to zero animations (`0 rAF`) when idle, alerting, hidden, or under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Dual rings and context bars patch DOM nodes in place for smooth transitions. - **Concentric dual quota rings (Outer = Weekly, Inner = 5h).** Shows **Gemini** and **Claude** side-by-side with outer weekly and inner 5h rings, always-visible percentages, and reset-countdown tooltips (Orchestrator aliases merge cleanly into Gemini — no bogus "Shared" pool). - **Context health & bottom-left quick `/compact`.** Tracks the active auto-compaction ceiling (`512k`/`256k`, not nominal `1M`), segmented by system prompt, tools, and messages, with compaction count and cache hit %. Includes a bottom-left **Compact** button (2-click safety confirm, disabled while busy; sends `/compact` in MCP App or copies to clipboard in standalone mode). - **Auto-open for new & existing chats + reliable focus sync.** Uses a once-per-conversation `PreInvocation` hook and eager `open` tool registration (`BETTER_VIEW_AUTO_OPEN=0` disables it), plus same-millisecond `last_user_view_time` tie-breaking so switching conversations follows accurately (especially with **Pin Tab**). - **Thinking effort guard.** Highlights the active model & effort (`⚡ Neon (xhigh)`) and warns if effort jumped above your recent baseline after a restart or project switch. - **Stall & runaway-loop detection.** Checks every conversation every 2 seconds, attaching evidence, a suggestion, and thresholds learned from your history: | Verdict | When | |---|---| | Needs you | Agent asked a question, or Antigravity awaits approval | | Slower than usual | Command or model call is much slower than your norm | | Looks stuck | Far slower than usual, or idle for 1 min after an error | | Runaway | Repetitive identical tool loop or 2.5M+ token burn in one open turn | | Stopped, unfinished | Antigravity went idle before the turn finished | | Service exited | Background service stopped while an agent was working | Manual stops and `/compact` do not trigger alerts. Multiple alerts collapse into a stack (top 1 expanded) so the team diagram stays above the fold. - **Lightweight MCP App actions.** Send `"continue"`, attach diagnostic context to your next prompt, start a fresh handoff chat (two-click confirm), or click a file step in the activity log to open it in the side pane. - **Teamwork diagram & master progress.** Compact expandable progress bar plus one-screen topology; finished groups collapse automatically. - **Native-icon macOS notifications.** `install-plugin.sh` compiles a lightweight `BetterViewNotify.app` (`UNUserNotificationCenter` with Better View's app icon; clicking a notification activates Antigravity, falling back to `osascript` if absent). Fires on *Needs you*, *Looks stuck*, *Runaway*, *Stopped, unfinished*, and 3+ min completions. - **Clean activity log.** Steps across all agents, newest first; consecutive reads fold into one row, and `update_focus`/`update_steps` meta-tools are filtered out. - **Bilingual.** Follows Antigravity's language, with a top-right **中/EN** toggle. > Skips redraws when idle and pauses updates while selecting text, so commands and errors are easy to copy. ## Requirements - macOS (notifications use `osascript`) - Antigravity 2.35+ (tested on 2.35.2) - Node.js 22+ (auto-detected via `PATH`, Homebrew, Volta, nvm; override with `BETTER_VIEW_NODE`) ## Install ```bash git clone https://github.com/ytsu-ki/better-view.git cd better-view && sh scripts/install-plugin.sh ``` Validates via `agy plugin validate --strict` (if found) and installs to `~/.gemini/config/plugins/better-view`. Restart Antigravity (or refresh the `better-view_view` MCP server) after installing or updating. - **Open:** Auto-opens in the side pane on the first tool-calling turn of a multi-step session, or manually from the side pane **+** menu (or **Overview ▸ Extensions**) → **Better View**. - **Uninstall:** Remove `~/.gemini/config/plugins/better-view` and restart Antigravity. - **Browser mode:** Run `npm start` to open the panel at http://127.0.0.1:47321/. ## Settings Set via environment variables (under `env` in `mcp.json` / `mcp_config.json` for the plugin): | Variable | Effect | |---|---| | `BETTER_VIEW_AUTO_OPEN` | `0` disables auto-open on new sessions | | `BETTER_VIEW_NOTIFY` | `0` disables notifications | | `BETTER_VIEW_LANG` | `zh` or `en` (overrides **中/EN** button) | | `BETTER_VIEW_NODE` | Custom `node` path | | `BETTER_VIEW_PORT` | `npm start` port (default `47321`) | | `BETTER_VIEW_AG_DIR` | Antigravity data dir (default `~/.gemini/antigravity`) | ## Privacy & Data Read-only toward Antigravity; nothing leaves your machine. - **Reads:** `~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/` (transcripts, `task.md`), `annotations/` (titles), `conversations/.db` (context breakdown, read-only), and Antigravity's local language server on `127.0.0.1` (status, quota, live context). - **Writes:** `~/.cache/better-view/` (language, learned limits, notification process) and `~/Library/Logs/better-view/mcp.log` (start/stop and method names only, no content). - **Listens:** `127.0.0.1` only. Runs in the side pane as a pure MCP App (with standalone browser mode via `npm start`). ## Development ```bash npm test ``` Simulate a Teamwork run (one stalled worker, one slow) at http://127.0.0.1:47403/: ```bash node test/sim-team.mjs /tmp/bv-team-sim ``` > Deletes and recreates the target folder—use a temp path. Design notes (in Chinese): [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md). ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
